metric: Mean held-out observation log likelihood (higher is better; not accuracy or calibrated clinical risk)
assumptions: Independent censoring and noninformative assessment schedule
First threshold crossing modeled within last-zero/first-positive interval; CDR may fluctuate
limitations: Synthetic MRI effect is imposed by the generator, not a discovery.
No ADNI training, external validation, personal prognosis, or clinical accuracy claim.
preprocessing: Training-only median imputation and standardization; held-out participants never used to fit.
split: Stratified 75/25 split by participant; fixed seed; no model selection on test results.

generator.censoring: independent uniform 365–1825 days, last scheduled visit
